Why Patients Leave
The top 4 reasons patients drop out of clinical trials.
1
Fear of the unknown
No one explained what to actually expect day-to-day.
2
Lack of emotional support
Protocols don't address anxiety, isolation, or doubt.
3
Mistrust in the system
Especially among historically underserved communities.
4
No connection to others
Participants feel alone in an inherently isolating experience.
